name: Blue Focus · employee
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create realistic production-quality HopFlows role-specific homepage UI, flat edge-to-edge desktop app screenshot, target dimensions 1440 x 1024. No browser chrome, device frame, perspective, watermark, cropped text, or multiple designs in one image. Crisp readable English product text. Current date anchor Tuesday 13 October 2026; current week 12–16 October. Sample data is illustrative. Focused primary screen, not a feature inventory. Use spacing, grouping and typography first, subtle dividers next, borders sparingly, no nested cards or gratuitous panels. Body type 14–16px equivalent, comfortably readable. Brand exactly "HopFlows". The product follows Goal → Deliverable → Task → Checklist. Keep employee execution, lead delivery and leadership outcomes distinct. No points, badges, leaderboards, AI chatbot, invented automation, performance rankings, gratuitous KPI tiles, or extra features. One main page action; deeper content behind See all or Menu. No rabbit mascot near help, risk, urgent or confidential content. Every sample must contain only one homepage for one role.
Visual direction Blue Focus: precise, contemporary B2B SaaS. Bright white and cool mist-gray, cobalt blue primary action, deep navy text, minimal 8px corners, restrained linear icons, no gradients. Layout strategy compact top navigation instead of tall sidebar, broad aligned working surface. For employee, first priority enlarged as a focus area with remaining two in clean rows below and small agenda right. For lead, actionable Needs you column left and team heatmap/risk sections aligned right. For leadership, three full-width goal rows with strongly aligned baseline/actual/target measures and a distinct risk column. Strong typography, no decorative imagery.
Employee homepage answers "What should I do next?". Show Today selected, Calendar, Inbox and Menu in navigation, title "Today", greeting "Good morning, Dara", date "Tue, 13 Oct", main global action "+ Add work". Exactly three priorities: "Review checkout screens" due today and labeled "Planned this week"; "Update ordering API notes" due tomorrow; "Prepare release checklist" due Thu, 15 Oct. Task actions "Start", "Done", "Need Help", with Start visually strongest. Show two meetings "10:00 Design check-in" and "14:30 Release review", next-two-day deadline "API notes · Tomorrow". A tiny unobtrusive private streak "4 working days" is optional, without mascot. No Goals, reports, other people's work or workload hours.
